lifecycleClasses.description: Active architectural or operational root that remains part of the primary visible structure.
Ownership has shifted or converged elsewhere, but the root still carries lineage, runtime, or compatibility value.
Historical or reference-only root retained for evidence, comparison, or migration context.
Low-value root that may be archived or retired later after explicit review.

exposureClasses.description: May appear in public-facing docs/navigation material, but not as a full source delivery promise.
Candidate for curated public package/repo/release export after separate approval.
Internal working surface; not intended for direct public release.
Enterprise-private or commercially sensitive surface that should remain non-public by default.

roots.rationale: Retained strategy and lineage root. Current posture reduces exposure through curation, not path churn.
High-density frozen reference root. Preserve path stability and data retention; explain structure through extracted docs instead of relocation.
High-density frozen reference root. Preserve path stability and data retention; explain structure through extracted docs instead of relocation.
Active internal workspace-safe template source for local workspace rule-pack materialization; public-safe export requires separate curation.

projectionBoundary: Public distribution roots only; private source registry remains authoritative for provenance. Classification alone does not authorize publication.
